items.title: Knuth equivalent matchings have the same core
items.author: Avichai Marmor
items.work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled lemma at source lines 1128-1130, the first of the two steps into which the author splits the proof of the theorem that two matchings are Knuth equivalent if and only if they have the same core. It states that two Knuth equivalent matchings have equal cores. The author gave it no label, so its position in the article is part of its identity. The proof (source lines 1131-1133) is short but requires a step that the statement hides: Knuth equivalence is generated by elementary Knuth transformations, so the invariant has to be checked on a single elementary transformation, and that check is done by comparing which chords the reduction process removes before and after the transformation. The statement mentions neither the reduction to one transformation nor the comparison of removed-chord sets.

primary.label: unlabelled lemma at source lines 1128-1130 (Step 1 of the proof of the Knuth-equivalence theorem)

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the unlabelled lemma, retained line for line
